senses.zh: 後續行動；追蹤報導；回診

examples.en: The manager sent a follow-up after the meeting.
examples.zh: 經理在會後發送了後續訊息。

examples.en: I have a follow-up with my dentist next Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我下週二要回診看牙醫。

examples.en: The magazine published a follow-up to last month's story.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌刊出了上個月那篇報導的後續。

examples.en: Please answer the follow-up questions on the next page.
examples.zh: 請回答下一頁的後續問題。

examples.en: She made a follow-up call to confirm the order.
examples.zh: 她又打了一通電話來確認訂單。

examples.en: The doctor suggested a follow-up visit in two weeks.
examples.zh: 醫師建議兩週後再回診一次。

examples.en: The news program showed footage of the parade.
examples.zh: 新聞節目播出了遊行的影像畫面。

examples.en: We watched old footage of our school sports day.
examples.zh: 我們看了學校運動會的舊影片。

examples.en: The museum has rare footage from the 1960s.
examples.zh: 這間博物館收藏了一九六〇年代的珍貴影像。

examples.en: I heard a footstep behind me in the hallway.
examples.zh: 我聽到走廊上我身後有腳步聲。

examples.en: Her footstep was light as she crossed the room.
examples.zh: 她走過房間時腳步很輕。

examples.en: We followed his footsteps up the muddy trail.
examples.zh: 我們沿著他的足跡走上泥濘的小徑。

examples.en: Parking is forbidden in front of the school gate.
examples.zh: 學校大門前禁止停車。

examples.en: Eating in the library is strictly forbidden.
examples.zh: 圖書館內嚴禁進食。

examples.en: The children were curious about the forbidden room upstairs.
examples.zh: 孩子們對樓上那間禁止進入的房間很好奇。

examples.en: She is the foremost expert on bird migration in Taiwan.
examples.zh: 她是台灣研究鳥類遷徙的頭號專家。

examples.en: Safety is our foremost concern on school trips.
examples.zh: 安全是我們校外教學時最重要的考量。

examples.en: He is one of the foremost writers of his time.
examples.zh: 他是那個時代最傑出的作家之一。

examples.en: First and foremost, thank you all for coming.
examples.zh: 首先，感謝大家的蒞臨。

examples.en: Please remember, first and foremost, to bring your ID card.
examples.zh: 請務必先記得帶身分證。

examples.en: The company is, first and foremost, a family business.
examples.zh: 這家公司說到底是一家家族企業。

examples.en: We will be on vacation for a fortnight in July.
examples.zh: 我們七月會去度假兩週。

examples.en: The report is due in a fortnight.
examples.zh: 報告兩週後到期。

examples.en: It rained almost every day for a fortnight.
examples.zh: 連續兩週幾乎天天下雨。

examples.en: My grandmother is old and rather frail now.
examples.zh: 我奶奶年紀大了，現在身體相當虛弱。

examples.en: The frail bridge could not hold heavy trucks.
examples.zh: 這座脆弱的橋承受不了重型卡車。

examples.en: He felt frail after a week in bed with the flu.
examples.zh: 他因流感臥床一週後，覺得身體很虛弱。

senses.zh: 法郎（瑞士等國的貨幣單位）

examples.en: The souvenir cost ten francs in Geneva.
examples.zh: 這個紀念品在日內瓦要十法郎。

examples.en: The franc was the currency of France before the euro.
examples.zh: 法國在採用歐元之前使用法郎。

examples.en: Swiss francs are accepted at most shops here.
examples.zh: 這裡大多數商店都收瑞士法郎。

examples.en: Don't fret about the test; you studied hard.
examples.zh: 別為考試煩惱，你已經很用功了。

examples.en: She fretted over every small detail of the party.
examples.zh: 她對派對的每個小細節都很操心。

examples.en: Parents often fret when their children travel alone.
examples.zh: 孩子獨自旅行時，父母常常會擔心。

senses.zh: 琴衍（指板上的金屬橫條）；焦慮

examples.en: He was in a fret about the missing keys.
examples.zh: 他為了不見的鑰匙焦躁不安。

examples.en: Press the string just behind the second fret.
examples.zh: 把琴弦按在緊靠第二條琴衍後方的位置。

examples.en: The fret on this old guitar needs repair.
examples.zh: 這把舊吉他的那條琴衍需要修理。

examples.en: The village lies on the fringe of the forest.
examples.zh: 這個村莊位於森林的邊緣。

examples.en: The scarf has a long fringe at both ends.
examples.zh: 這條圍巾兩端都有長長的流蘇。

examples.en: She cut her fringe before the school photo.
examples.zh: 她在拍學校照片前剪了劉海。

examples.en: The fringe group has very few members.
examples.zh: 這個非主流團體的成員非常少。

examples.en: He enjoys fringe theater more than big musicals.
examples.zh: 比起大型音樂劇，他更喜歡非主流劇場。

examples.en: The company offers fringe benefits such as free meals and gym access.
examples.zh: 公司提供免費餐點及健身房使用權等額外福利。

examples.en: The accident was front-page news this morning.
examples.zh: 這起意外是今天早上的頭版新聞。

examples.en: Her photo appeared in a front-page story.
examples.zh: 她的照片出現在一篇頭版報導中。

examples.en: The mayor's speech made a front-page headline.
examples.zh: 市長的演說登上了頭版標題。

examples.en: We had a fruitful discussion about the project.
examples.zh: 我們就這個專案進行了一場很有成果的討論。

examples.en: Her fruitful career lasted more than thirty years.
examples.zh: 她成果豐碩的事業持續了三十多年。

examples.en: The farmer hopes for a fruitful harvest this autumn.
examples.zh: 農夫希望今年秋天能有豐收。

examples.en: The fumes from the traffic made me cough.
examples.zh: 車流的廢氣讓我咳嗽。

examples.en: Open the window to let the paint fumes out.
examples.zh: 打開窗戶，讓油漆揮發的氣體散出去。

examples.en: Workers must wear masks to avoid breathing in the fumes.
examples.zh: 工人必須戴口罩，以免吸入煙霧。

examples.en: The professor wrote a book about religious fundamentalism.
examples.zh: 那位教授寫了一本關於宗教基本教義派的書。

examples.en: Fundamentalism can appear in many different religions.
examples.zh: 基本教義主義可能出現在許多不同的宗教中。

examples.en: Students discussed the rise of fundamentalism in class.
examples.zh: 學生們在課堂上討論了原教旨主義的興起。

examples.en: The article describes a fundamentalist who rejects modern ideas.
examples.zh: 這篇文章描述了一位排斥現代觀念的基本教義派人士。

examples.en: A fundamentalist usually follows religious texts very strictly.
examples.zh: 基本教義派信徒通常嚴格遵守宗教經典。

examples.en: The writer interviewed a former fundamentalist about his life.
examples.zh: 作者訪問了一位前基本教義派人士，談他的人生。

examples.en: The town has a fundamentalist church on the hill.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮的山丘上有一間基本教義派的教會。

examples.en: She grew up in a fundamentalist family.
examples.zh: 她在一個基本教義派的家庭中長大。

examples.en: Fundamentalist views are strongly debated in this country.
examples.zh: 基本教義派的觀點在這個國家引起很大的爭論。

examples.en: The school received new funding for its science lab.
examples.zh: 學校為科學實驗室獲得了新的經費。

examples.en: The charity depends on funding from local businesses.
examples.zh: 這個慈善機構仰賴當地企業的資助。

examples.en: Without enough funding, the project may stop next year.
examples.zh: 如果沒有足夠的資金，這個專案明年可能會中止。

examples.en: The old furnace in the basement started making noise.
examples.zh: 地下室那台老舊的暖氣爐開始發出噪音。

examples.en: Iron is melted in a hot furnace at the factory.
examples.zh: 鐵在工廠裡的高溫熔爐中被熔化。

examples.en: Dad turned on the furnace when winter came.
examples.zh: 冬天一到，爸爸就打開了暖氣爐。

examples.en: The restaurant serves a fusion of Taiwanese and Italian food.
examples.zh: 這間餐廳提供台灣與義大利融合的料理。

examples.en: Nuclear fusion is how the sun makes its energy.
examples.zh: 核融合是太陽產生能量的方式。

examples.en: The band plays a fusion of jazz and rock.
examples.zh: 這個樂團演奏爵士與搖滾融合的音樂。

examples.en: Water becomes gaseous when it is heated enough.
examples.zh: 水加熱到足夠的程度就會變成氣態。

examples.en: The teacher showed us a gaseous substance in a jar.
examples.zh: 老師讓我們看了一罐裡面的氣態物質。

examples.en: Oxygen is a gaseous element found in the air.
examples.zh: 氧是存在於空氣中的氣態元素。

examples.en: He put some gel in his hair before school.
examples.zh: 他上學前在頭髮上抹了一些髮膠。

examples.en: The nurse spread a cool gel on my sore arm.
examples.zh: 護理師在我痠痛的手臂上塗了涼涼的凝膠。

examples.en: The hotel provides shower gel that smells like fresh oranges.
examples.zh: 飯店提供的沐浴凝露帶有新鮮柳橙的香味。

examples.en: Leave the dessert in the fridge until it gels.
examples.zh: 把甜點放在冰箱裡，直到它凝固。

examples.en: Our ideas finally began to gel during the meeting.
examples.zh: 我們的想法在會議中終於開始成形。

examples.en: The new team members gelled quickly with the staff.
examples.zh: 新的團隊成員很快就和同事融洽相處。

examples.en: It is unfair to generalize from just one bad meal.
examples.zh: 光憑一頓不好吃的餐點就概括而論並不公平。

examples.en: Scientists generalize from many small experiments when developing a new theory.
examples.zh: 科學家在發展新理論時，會從許多小實驗中概括推論。

examples.en: Try not to generalize about people from other countries.
examples.zh: 盡量不要對其他國家的人以偏概全。

examples.en: She studies geology at a university in Hualien.
examples.zh: 她在花蓮的一所大學讀地質學。

examples.en: Students examined local rocks to understand the geology of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 學生們透過檢視當地岩石，了解台灣的地質。

examples.en: Our teacher took us to a museum of geology.
examples.zh: 老師帶我們去參觀一間地質博物館。

senses.zh: 貧民區（可帶貶義）；被迫隔離的族群居住區（歷史用語）

examples.en: The history book describes families forced to live in a ghetto during the war.
examples.zh: 歷史課本描述了戰爭期間被迫住在隔離居住區裡的家庭。

examples.en: The book describes life in a poor city ghetto.
examples.zh: 這本書描述了城市貧民區的生活。

examples.en: The dictionary notes that ghetto can be a derogatory term for a poor neighborhood.
examples.zh: 字典指出，ghetto 可能是對貧困社區帶有貶義的稱呼。

examples.en: The frame was covered in gilt that shone under the gallery lights.
examples.zh: 相框表面覆著金色塗層，在藝廊燈光下閃閃發亮。

examples.en: A thin layer of gilt shone on the old clock.
examples.zh: 一層薄薄的金漆在那座老鐘上閃閃發亮。

examples.en: The gilt on the cover has started to fade.
examples.zh: 封面上的鍍金開始褪色了。

examples.en: She wore a gilt bracelet to the dinner.
examples.zh: 她戴著一只鍍金手鐲去參加晚宴。

examples.en: The museum has a gilt statue near the entrance.
examples.zh: 博物館入口附近有一座鍍金雕像。

examples.en: A gilt mirror hung above the fireplace.
examples.zh: 壁爐上方掛著一面鍍金的鏡子。

examples.en: Given the heavy rain, we cancelled the picnic.
examples.zh: 考慮到雨勢很大，我們取消了野餐。

examples.en: Given his age, he runs remarkably fast.
examples.zh: 就他的年紀而言，他跑得相當快。

examples.en: She did well, given how little time she had.
examples.zh: 考慮到她的時間那麼少，她表現得很好。

examples.en: Students must finish the test in a given time.
examples.zh: 學生必須在規定的時間內完成考試。

examples.en: At any given moment, hundreds of planes are in the air.
examples.zh: 在任何特定時刻，都有數百架飛機在空中。

examples.en: Choose a given word and write a short story.
examples.zh: 選一個指定的字，寫一篇短篇故事。

examples.en: The actress added glamor to the movie premiere with her elegant dress.
examples.zh: 那位女演員以優雅洋裝為電影首映會增添迷人光彩。

examples.en: Many people dream of the glamor of a famous singer's life.
examples.zh: 許多人嚮往知名歌手生活的光鮮亮麗。

examples.en: The old hotel still has a touch of glamor.
examples.zh: 這間老飯店仍然帶著一絲迷人的氣派。

examples.en: The doctor checked the gland in my neck.
examples.zh: 醫師檢查了我脖子上的腺體。

examples.en: A gland in the mouth produces saliva.
examples.zh: 口腔裡有一種腺體會分泌唾液。

examples.en: The thyroid is a small gland that controls the body's energy.
examples.zh: 甲狀腺是一個調節身體能量的小腺體。

examples.en: We keep the glassware in the top cupboard.
examples.zh: 我們把玻璃器皿放在最上層的櫥櫃裡。

examples.en: The store sells beautiful glassware from Italy.
examples.zh: 這家店販售來自義大利的漂亮玻璃製品。

examples.en: Please wash the laboratory glassware carefully after you finish the experiment.
examples.zh: 做完實驗後，請小心清洗實驗室的玻璃器皿。

examples.en: The children shouted with glee when it snowed.
examples.zh: 下雪時孩子們開心地大叫。

examples.en: She opened the gift with great glee.
examples.zh: 她興高采烈地拆開了禮物。

examples.en: There was glee in his voice after the win.
examples.zh: 獲勝之後，他的聲音裡充滿喜悅。

examples.en: The lake glistened in the morning sun.
examples.zh: 湖面在晨光中閃閃發亮。

examples.en: Drops of rain glistened on the leaves.
examples.zh: 雨滴在葉子上閃閃發光。

examples.en: His forehead glistened after the long run.
examples.zh: 長跑之後，他的額頭閃著汗光。

examples.en: The puppy likes to gnaw on an old shoe.
examples.zh: 那隻小狗喜歡啃一隻舊鞋子。

examples.en: Mice can gnaw through a plastic bag.
examples.zh: 老鼠可以咬穿塑膠袋。

examples.en: Worry began to gnaw at her before the exam.
examples.zh: 考試前，她開始被焦慮折磨。

examples.en: We are waiting for the go-ahead from the teacher.
examples.zh: 我們正在等老師的許可。

examples.en: The city gave the go-ahead for the new library.
examples.zh: 市政府核准了新圖書館的興建。

examples.en: She gave us the go-ahead to start the project.
examples.zh: 她同意我們開始進行這個專案。

senses.zh: 積極進取的；使取得領先的

examples.en: He is a go-ahead young manager who welcomes new ideas.
examples.zh: 他是一位積極進取的年輕經理，樂於接受新點子。

examples.en: The go-ahead company grew quickly last year.
examples.zh: 這間有衝勁的公司去年成長得很快。

examples.en: His go-ahead goal helped the team win the match.
examples.zh: 他的超前進球幫助球隊贏得比賽。

examples.en: The hungry boy gobbled his lunch in five minutes.
examples.zh: 那個飢餓的男孩五分鐘就把午餐狼吞虎嚥吃完了。

examples.en: Don't gobble your food; chew it slowly.
examples.zh: 別狼吞虎嚥，要慢慢咀嚼。

examples.en: The turkey began to gobble when the farmer opened the gate.
examples.zh: 農夫打開柵門時，那隻火雞開始咯咯叫。

examples.en: We heard a loud gobble from the farm.
examples.zh: 我們聽到農場傳來很響的火雞叫聲。

examples.en: The turkey let out a gobble when we came near.
examples.zh: 我們走近時，火雞發出了咯咯的叫聲。

examples.en: A gobble echoed across the field at dawn.
examples.zh: 黎明時，一聲火雞叫在田野間迴盪。

examples.en: The going was slow because of the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 因為下大雨，進展很緩慢。

examples.en: We were saddened by her going after twenty years at the company.
examples.zh: 她在公司工作二十年後離去，讓我們感到難過。

examples.en: The first chapter was hard going for most readers.
examples.zh: 第一章對大多數讀者來說很難讀。

examples.en: What is the going rate for a haircut here?
examples.zh: 這裡剪頭髮現在的行情價是多少？

examples.en: The going price of eggs went up this month.
examples.zh: 雞蛋這個月的現行價格上漲了。

examples.en: He asked about the going salary for new teachers.
examples.zh: 他詢問了新進老師目前的薪資水準。

examples.en: The movie was criticized for having too much gore.
examples.zh: 這部電影因血腥場面過多而受到批評。

examples.en: Some parents avoid games full of gore.
examples.zh: 有些家長避開充滿血腥畫面的遊戲。

examples.en: The teacher chose a story with no gore at all.
examples.zh: 老師選了一篇完全沒有血腥畫面的故事。

examples.en: A bull may gore anyone who enters its field.
examples.zh: 公牛可能會用角頂傷進入牠場地的人。

examples.en: The farmer built a fence to prevent the bull from goring visitors.
examples.zh: 農夫築起圍欄，防止公牛用角頂傷訪客。

examples.en: The biography mentions a farmer who was gored by a bull.
examples.zh: 傳記提到一名曾被公牛用角頂傷的農夫。

examples.en: We hiked through a deep gorge in Hualien.
examples.zh: 我們在花蓮健行穿越了一道深邃的峽谷。

examples.en: A river runs through the narrow gorge.
examples.zh: 一條河流穿過狹窄的峽谷。

examples.en: The bridge crosses a gorge near the village.
examples.zh: 這座橋橫跨村莊附近的一道峽谷。

examples.en: They gorged on cake at the birthday party.
examples.zh: 他們在生日派對上大吃蛋糕。

examples.en: Don't gorge yourself before the swimming class.
examples.zh: 游泳課之前不要吃太撐。

examples.en: The kids gorged themselves on fruit at the picnic.
examples.zh: 孩子們在野餐時猛吃水果。

examples.en: The school received governmental support for the new gym.
examples.zh: 學校獲得政府支持來興建新體育館。

examples.en: She works for a governmental agency in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她在台北的一個政府機構工作。

examples.en: Governmental offices are closed on national holidays.
examples.zh: 政府機關在國定假日休息。

senses.zh: 磨碎；刨絲；發出刺耳聲；使煩躁

examples.en: Please grate the cheese for the pizza.
examples.zh: 請把披薩用的起司刨成絲。

examples.en: The door grated on its old hinges.
examples.zh: 那扇門的舊鉸鏈發出刺耳的摩擦聲。

examples.en: His loud voice began to grate on my nerves.
examples.zh: 他很大的聲音開始讓我心煩。

examples.en: Ashes fell through the grate of the fireplace.
examples.zh: 灰燼從壁爐的爐柵掉了下去。

examples.en: A metal grate covers the drain in the street.
examples.zh: 街上的排水孔蓋著一片金屬格柵。

examples.en: He cleaned the grate of the old stove.
examples.zh: 他清理了老舊爐子的爐柵。

examples.en: The grocer sells fresh fruit and vegetables.
examples.zh: 那位雜貨商賣新鮮的水果和蔬菜。

examples.en: My grandmother knows the grocer on our street.
examples.zh: 我奶奶認識我們那條街上的雜貨店老闆。

examples.en: We bought eggs from the local grocer.
examples.zh: 我們向當地的雜貨商買了雞蛋。

senses.zh: 凹槽；律動；得心應手的狀態

examples.en: Slide the sliding door along the groove.
examples.zh: 把拉門沿著凹槽滑動。

examples.en: The drummer created a steady groove that made everyone want to dance.
examples.zh: 鼓手打出穩定的律動，讓每個人都想跳舞。

examples.en: After a month, I finally found my groove at work.
examples.zh: 一個月後，我終於在工作上找到了節奏。

examples.en: He groped for the light switch in the dark.
examples.zh: 他在黑暗中摸索電燈開關。

examples.en: She groped in her bag for her keys.
examples.zh: 她在包包裡摸索鑰匙。

examples.en: We groped our way along the dark tunnel.
examples.zh: 我們沿著漆黑的隧道摸索前進。

examples.en: We had a picnic in a grove of old trees.
examples.zh: 我們在一片老樹林裡野餐。

examples.en: An orange grove lies behind the farmhouse.
examples.zh: 農舍後面有一座柳橙園。

examples.en: The path leads through a quiet bamboo grove.
examples.zh: 小徑穿過一片安靜的竹林。

examples.en: This laptop has a guaranteed battery life of ten hours.
examples.zh: 這台筆電的電池續航力保證有十小時。

examples.en: Success is not guaranteed, but you should try.
examples.zh: 成功並沒有保證，但你應該試試。

examples.en: The store offers guaranteed delivery by Friday.
examples.zh: 這家店提供保證最晚在週五送達的服務。

examples.en: The guerrilla hid in the mountains for many years.
examples.zh: 那位游擊隊員在山區躲了好多年。

examples.en: The museum displays a map used by a guerrilla.
examples.zh: 博物館展出了一位游擊隊員使用過的地圖。

examples.en: A former guerrilla now teaches history at a school.
examples.zh: 一位前游擊隊員現在在學校教歷史。

examples.en: The movie shows a guerrilla war in the jungle.
examples.zh: 這部電影呈現了叢林中的游擊戰。

examples.en: The group used guerrilla tactics against a larger army.
examples.zh: 這個團體對抗較大的軍隊時使用了游擊戰術。

examples.en: Some artists use guerrilla marketing to promote their work.
examples.zh: 有些藝術家用游擊式行銷來宣傳作品。

examples.en: In the past, each trade had its own guild.
examples.zh: 過去，每一種行業都有自己的行會。

examples.en: She joined the writers' guild last spring.
examples.zh: 她去年春天加入了作家協會。

examples.en: The guild helps members find work and training.
examples.zh: 這個公會協助會員找工作和接受訓練。

examples.en: The guitarist played a slow song at the concert.
examples.zh: 吉他手在音樂會上彈奏了一首慢歌。

examples.en: My brother wants to become a professional guitarist.
examples.zh: 我哥哥想成為專業的吉他手。

examples.en: The school band is looking for a new guitarist.
examples.zh: 學校的樂團正在找一位新的吉他手。

senses.zh: 大口吞嚥；緊張地吞口水

examples.en: He gulped down a glass of water after the race.
examples.zh: 比賽結束後，他一口氣喝下一杯水。

examples.en: She gulped before opening the test results.
examples.zh: 她在打開成績單前緊張地吞了口口水。

examples.en: Don't gulp your soup; it is still hot.
examples.zh: 不要大口灌湯，它還很燙。

examples.en: He drank the juice in one gulp.
examples.zh: 他一口氣喝掉了果汁。

examples.en: She took a big gulp of air before diving.
examples.zh: 她潛水前吸了一大口氣。

examples.en: With a nervous gulp, he walked onto the stage.
examples.zh: 他緊張地吞了口口水，走上了舞台。

examples.en: The film begins with a gunman entering a bank.
examples.zh: 這部電影一開始是一名持槍者走進銀行。

examples.en: Police said the gunman had left before they arrived.
examples.zh: 警方表示，持槍者在他們抵達前已經離開。

examples.en: The security guard in the movie stopped the gunman.
examples.zh: 電影中的保全人員攔下了那名持槍者。

examples.en: A strong gust blew my hat off.
examples.zh: 一陣強風把我的帽子吹走了。

examples.en: Gusts of wind shook the windows all night.
examples.zh: 陣陣強風整晚搖晃著窗戶。

examples.en: A sudden gust scattered the papers across the desk.
examples.zh: 突然一陣風把桌上的紙吹散了。

examples.en: The wind gusted up to eighty kilometers per hour.
examples.zh: 陣風風速最高達每小時八十公里。

examples.en: It was gusting hard when we left the station.
examples.zh: 我們離開車站時風正一陣陣地猛吹。

examples.en: The weather report says the wind will gust tonight.
examples.zh: 氣象報告說今晚風會陣陣強勁地颳起。

senses.zh: 吉普賽人（現多視為冒犯用語，建議用羅姆人）

examples.en: Many Romani people prefer not to be called a gypsy.
examples.zh: 許多羅姆人不喜歡被稱為吉普賽人。

examples.en: The old novel uses the word gypsy in its title.
examples.zh: 這本舊小說的書名用了吉普賽人這個詞。

examples.en: Our teacher explained why the word gypsy can offend people.
examples.zh: 老師說明了為什麼吉普賽人這個詞可能冒犯別人。
